response.sql: SELECT operation, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans WHERE amount > 2400 GROUP BY operation

assumptions.assumption: NULL operation values form their own group; GROUP BY puts NULLs into a single group, so no special handling is needed. Empty-string operations, if any, would be a separate group.
Transactions of type VYBER (or any type other than PRIJEM/VYDAJ) are excluded from the average, since the CASE returns NULL for them, but are still counted in transaction_count.
